messages:
Tara (PM): Quick sync: final design review for the "trace explorer" panel. Focus: making exports safe and making correlation ids frictionless for support.
Diego (Design): Uploaded a compact prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzz/trace-explorer-v2. Two major updates: sticky header with correlation-id pill + compact stack list that expands inline.
Hannah (Frontend): layout looks good. Implementation note: avoid fetching full span payloads on initial load for big traces. We'll lazy-load when a frame is expanded.
Ravi (Backend): agreed. API plan: /traces/{id}?summary=true for initial load, then /traces/{id}/frames/{frame_id}?full=1 on expand. Exports will be async (202 + export id) and stream to object store.
Noemi (A11y): a11y quick wins: make correlation pill a real button with aria-label="Copy correlation id"; ensure keyboard can open history flyout and copy. Also timeline scrubber needs keyboard steps and aria-valuetext updates.
Diego (Design): for export UI I'm proposing an "Export" primary with menu: JSON, HAR. If user toggles "include payloads" we show a mandatory PII confirmation checkbox and explainer text.
Tara (PM): Requirements: explicit opt-in for payloads, analytics events for export steps, and rate-limits to avoid export storms. Also show a small inline warning when trace size > 5MB.
Hannah (Frontend): UX: show an accessible toast after copy (role/status) with message "Correlation ID copied" and include a small undo link for accidental copies. We'll emit analytics event trace.copy.
Ravi (Backend): Server rules: if include_payloads=true then check user perms else 403. Exports queued, each org max 3 concurrent exports. Return signed URL when complete. Sample: POST /api/v1/traces/{id}/export -> 202 {"export_id":"ex_42"}.
Noemi (A11y): Modal/accessibility: export modal must trap focus, have aria-modal and aria-labelledby, focus the first actionable (PII checkbox or confirm) on open. All tooltips must be reachable via keyboard info buttons.
Diego (Design): Microcopy: change "Duration" -> "Latency (ms)" in hover cards, "Start" -> "Request start". For PII explainer: "Exporting full payloads may include sensitive customer data. Confirm you have authorization."
Tara (PM): Nice. Add link to export policy in that explainer. Decision: show correlation pill in header, inline copy + history flyout, exports async with opt-in payloads and PII confirmation, accessibility fixes. Owners: Diego (design), Hannah (frontend), Ravi (backend), Noemi (a11y).
deploy-bot: Deploy planned: trace-explorer-v2 -> staging on 2026-05-04T07:30Z
Hannah (Frontend): I'll prototype keyboard copy + accessible toast and add a client-side debounce on the export button.
Ravi (Backend): I'll add export job queue + signed-url endpoint, plus org-level concurrency limit. Also will include an audit log entry for exports.
Noemi (A11y): I'll run a keyboard and screen-reader pass after Diego's update. Small follow-up: ensure color contrast for stack badges >= 4.5:1 at small sizes.
Diego (Design): will push updated frames and microcopy to Figma by EOD. Ping me for quick copy edits.
Tara (PM): thanks team. If no blockers i'll merge these decisions into the alpha branch tomorrow
